games.name: Million Layer Gift Simulator
games.description: A giant gift with 1,000,000 layers of wrapping paper. Peel it strip by strip, sell the paper, and buy better tools, from nail clippers to a leaf blower. Play alone or with up to 4 friends. What’s inside? There’s only one way to find out.

games.name: Void Drive
games.description: Chain your cars together and drive across roads hanging over the void. If one falls, everyone falls. Jump, crash and laugh through 17 trap-filled worlds with up to 3 friends online, or go solo and chase your best time.

games.name: Lost in the Post
games.description: Fly a rickety hot-air balloon with 2-4 friends and deliver the mail across a world that wants you dead. Work the burner, drop the ballast, catch the parcels, slap your crewmates, and try not to fall out. We always deliver. Mostly.

games.name: Bot Jump
games.description: Jump, shoot and keep moving in Bot Jump, a side-scrolling platformer for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Guide little robots through changing scenery, blast enemies out of the way and link up with friends by rope. How far can you go together?

games.name: Break Even
games.description: You owe your boss a billion dollars. Smash repossessed furniture with a hammer, set off chain reactions, and spend the coins on bigger hammers and upgrades in this active incremental roguelite. Can’t make the payment? You’re fired.

games.name: A Sheet-ton of Bingo
games.description: Fill one whole bingo sheet out of a thousand before the old regular across the hall yells BINGO. Call numbers, dab squares and buy auto-daubers in this incremental race to find the bingo in a sheet haystack. He has been doing this for decades. You have no idea how good he is.

games.name: No, I'm Not Addicted to Opening Packs
games.description: Rip open packs in this incremental trading card game! Collect hundreds of unique cards across themed sets, upgrade your packs, sacrifice cards for rewards and complete challenges to earn stars for permanent upgrades. Chase the rarest pulls and build your ultimate collection!

games.name: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone
games.description: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone is a neon top-down shooter. Customize your ship's left and right cannons, fight through branching rooms, collect gear, and build powerful weapon combos. Face geometric enemies, elite threats, and multi-phase bosses.

games.name: FootBall Inc
games.description: Take direct control of the rods in a physics-driven foosball game, then build the club behind every match. Master powerful shots, sign and develop players, climb four divisions, upgrade your facilities, and earn your place at the World Cup.

games.name: PokerCat Battle
games.description: Turn poker hands into powerful attacks in a fantasy adventure starring a sword-wielding cat. Bend your hand with Tarot cards, battle bosses, collect gear, and grow stronger. Play each hand yourself or let auto-battle run in a compact desktop bar.

games.name: Bitnook
games.description: A cozy idle game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Tiny Bit Friends guard your desktop from mischievous bugs while you work: they fight, build and grow on their own, and parade out to tell you what they did when you come back.

games.name: Magical Girl: incremental gaiden
games.description: Start as a weak Magical Girl and become an unstoppable force! Fight weird Shadows, collect resources, unlock powerful upgrades, and annihilate the Witches in this Incremental Bullet Hell!

games.name: Super Galaxy Gladiator
games.description: Super Galaxy Gladiator is a survivor roguelite focused on buildcrafting and inventory management. Fight waves of enemies, buy and upgrade items mid-run, and arrange your gear to create insane builds and synergies in the galactic arena.

games.name: The Altar Boy Adventures
games.description: Step into the shoes of Józef, a young man and altar server in a Polish village. Repair electronic equipment, prepare the sacristy for Mass, and help your neighbors. Experience a unique and moving adventure centered around liturgical service.

games.name: Rolling Toolman 3: Darkness
games.description: Toolman is back in this 3prd person adventure game. Roll and try to reach goal as soon as you can and avoid falling from map and beware obstacles and traps

games.name: Rails of Fortune
games.description: Build your transport company across Europe from 1850. Connect cities with trains, ships and airships, carry passengers and supply factories. Plan profitable supply chains, research new technology and compete with rival companies.

games.name: Gemwood
games.description: Run a cozy jewelry workshop in the woods. Mine for gems, cut and polish them, then design rings, necklaces and brooches for your animal customers. Mix metals and decorations, wrap each order and haggle over the price, or craft freely and display your favorites.

games.name: The Grand Book Archive: Tidy Up
games.description: Restore The Grand Book Archive by sorting 2,990 books onto their rightful shelves. Use your observation and magical spells to organize the collection as quickly as possible. Explore a variety of book themes and discover endless possibilities within the archive.

games.name: Cat Survivor
games.description: Cat Survivor is a minefield auto-battler where mines become your greatest weapon. Read the numbers, place your flags, trigger explosive chain reactions, and wipe out entire hordes. Win with strategy, not brute force.

games.name: Plants Need Some Space
games.description: The world's sweetest grocery starts with a little cozy chaos. A mafia boss tomato, a comrade potato, a disco lettuce, and dozens more oddballs who can't stand each other. Good luck! Plant everyone in the right spot to sort out the chaos, sell the harvest, and design your own shop.

games.name: Sad Virus Mythic Land
games.description: Sad virus third person simulation adventure game series continue now in small map which include forest and castle themed adventure where mission avoid traps and collect bottles

games.name: Get Your Cards in a Row
games.description: Your uncle Jeff left you his game shop, and it's been ransacked. Put over 25,000 things back where they belong in this first-person physics sim. Dig through the heaps, unlock rooms, upgrade your tools, and tidy up alone or with up to 3 friends.

games.name: SCRAP RECLAIM スクラップ・リクレイム
games.description: Clear mountains of junk, sell it, and upgrade your tools! Go from bare hands to a drill and a vacuum to collect faster, and team up with tiny robots to clean out the warehouse. Assemble your means of escape and break out of the warehouse!

games.name: Idle Pirates
games.description: A pirate-themed incremental idle game! Destroy crates, collect treasure and venture deep into ships to rescue your crew to help you haul in even more loot. Fight your way deep into ships and take down mighty bosses.

games.name: Fart Together
games.description: Fart Together is a physics-based co-op game where 2–4 players steer a shared raft using fart power. Coordinate your direction, timing and gas power with friends to overcome challenging obstacle courses.

games.name: ANTARIUM 2
games.description: Long ago, the Old Colony filled these depths. Now your queen begins to dig. Grow a living ant colony in a cross-section of the earth, automate it with belts and machines, survive storms and raids, wake the ancient Engine, then fly to found a stronger colony.

games.name: Spin & Win: Casino Business Sim
games.description: Their luck. Your business. Build your casino, work the floor, and hire a crew to keep the cash flowing. Draw crowds with live shows, then join your guests for poker, blackjack, or a spin on the slots.

games.name: Vault Traitors
games.description: Social deduction with MOBA-style abilities, 25+ roles, 50+ unique items, an arsenal of weapons and air that's running out. 16 players are sealed in an underground vault with traitors among them. Lock your door - and survive the night.

games.name: Chessboxing Arcade
games.description: Chess Boxing Arcade is a 2D arcade take on the real sport: alternate between timed chess rounds and fast-paced boxing rounds. Win by checkmate, knockout or the clock against adaptive AI, friends locally, or opponents online.

games.name: Butt Out!
games.description: The neighbors are coming to drag you off the toilet. Feed the hero, combine foods, and aim a flexible pipe in this arcade wave defense game. Unlock new projectiles, stock up on food, build obstacles, and choose your upgrade path.

games.name: Pave The Universe
games.description: Your home planet sent you and your alien crew with one job: pave the whole planet, every last square metre. Dig, level, cut pavers to size, build factories and robots, and take over a wild little planet. Solo or with up to 8 friends.

games.name: A Gift for Everyone
games.description: New Year's is almost here! A mountain of gifts is piled up under a giant Christmas tree, with a toy in every box. Start with your bare mittens, sell the toys to Father Frost, hire a dwarf and mechanical arms, bring up to three friends and keep going until the last box is open. All 100,000 of them.

games.name: World's Worst Handyman
games.description: Suit up as the "World's Worst Handyman" in this comedy stealth game where every job is a chaotic adventure! Dodge disgruntled clients, bungle repairs, and save your beloved animal shelter from bankruptcy.

games.name: Seek Lot
games.description: Evolve a tiny neural-net brain that learns to drive a scrap buggy across 12 hazard-filled lots. Watch 100 ghost buggies a generation get sharper, buy sensors and upgrades, race your own or a friend's ghost (SL1: codes), export GIF bloopers, and prestige your lab. Pay once: no IAP.

games.name: Harventure
games.description: Harvest, collect and upgrade! Harventure is a short incremental game about harvesting and using resources on upgrades to purify islands from corruption.

games.name: Sweet Order: Candy Shop Tidy Up!
games.description: A magical candy shop is a sticky mess! Play as an adorable marshmallow in this cozy first-person cleaning and organizing sim. Vacuum up gummies, scrape away syrup, and sort colorful candies to perfection. No timers, no stress, just pure satisfaction!

games.name: Project Polygon
games.description: 32 players. 5 rounds. Nobody is ever eliminated. Race, dive and tumble through a chaotic TV game show armed with Goat Launchers, Chicken Rays and Black Hole Bombs. Get knocked over, bounce back up and climb the scoreboard – the Final counts double!

games.name: Phantom Shapes
games.description: An online co-op horror party game for 2 to 7 players. The Phantom hides a cursed shape that looks like a normal object and protects it. Up to 6 Workers search the map, argue about which thing is fake and confirm it before the Phantom catches them all. No microtransactions.

games.name: Who?
games.description: Who? is a game of deduction and chaos among friends. Each player uploads any photo from their computer, which is assigned to another participant. Everyone can see the others’ images, but not their own, and asks questions that can only be answered with “yes” or “no” to discover who—or what—they are.

games.name: Arcadeous
games.description: Own an arcade from minute one. Fill the floor with cabinets you can walk up to and actually play, set the ticket payout, stock the prize counter and keep the crowd coming back. A first-person arcade management sim where every machine is a real game.

games.name: Gang Birds
games.description: Gang Birds is a bluffing and deduction game around a table in a backroom. Your job and two hidden contacts decide whether you play for the Gang, the Cops or the Junkies. Play with friends, up to 10 at one table, in 1v1 duels or against bots.

games.name: Eyelord Returns
games.description: Eyelord is an intense, fast-paced, heavy metal match-3 pop 'em up. It is a relentless massacre of innocent rolling eyeballs, using a mouse, touchscreen, or game controller. Get into the flow alone, or bring a friend to the slaughter!

games.name: Pluralys: Exp.14
games.description: Discover Pluralys: Exp.14, a cozy indie adventure. Play as Elie on a day that seems ordinary... until his/her house fills up with friends and strangers. Why are they there, and how will you handle the situation? There's only one way to find out...

games.name: Swarm Chess
games.description: Chess with thousands of pieces. Place your towers then relax and watch the chaos of battle unfold in this incremental auto battler.

games.name: Pulp Friction
games.description: Fruit-on-fruit kitchen brawls! Roll, slice and parry as one of 18 living fruits, carve chunks off your rivals until their core shows and be the last fruit standing. 15 party modes for up to 8 players online or 4 on one couch, plus co-op raids against the mold.

games.name: Kicked Out
games.description: The bailiffs are at the door and you have only one minute. Throw what you can out of the window, then jump after it. Beg, dig through the trash, survive the nights and save $100 before the street breaks you.

games.name: Wharflet
games.description: Build a tiny fishing fleet on your desktop. Ride the waves, catch fish, sell and upgrade - all while you do other things. Just sit back and relax!

games.name: Plink Lab
games.description: A satisfying active plinko incremental where you drop and bounce fantastic creatures (tiny humans for starters) to clear pegs and earn a trillion $! Wacky balls, massive tech tree, total physics-based chaos, and a very chatty goblin shop owner.

games.name: TideLight
games.description: Spend the summer with Nana June on Gull Island: fish the pond, the brook and the sea, fix up Grandpa's old boat and light the lighthouse again. Then come back five summers later and sail an archipelago of nine islands to relight their tidelights, one keeper and one fishy problem at a time.

games.name: Blacksmith of sword master ~ IDLE ~
games.description: ■ Your Own Little Forge, Right on Your Desktop[BoS] Blacksmith of Sword Master ~IDLE~ is an idle RPG that runs in a small corner of your desktop.No matter what you're doing, the training never stops.Start with a humble forge and rise to become the greatest martial arts master!

games.name: My Cat Cafe Simulator
games.description: Build your dream cat café! Adopt adorable cats, care for them, and fill your café with love. Decorate your space, collect unique cats, play with your furry friends, and welcome happy customers. Grow your business and create the ultimate cozy paradise for CAT !!!

games.name: Idle Slot Machine
games.description: Build a bustling pixel-art casino in this idle management game. Hire monkeys to spin your slots, combine machines and chain reactions, shape your skill tree, and prestige for lasting progress. Collect cosmetics and take on challenges beyond the casino floor.

games.name: NoroiStation
games.description: This console is cursed. Play the cartridges one by one on an old CRT. If something is wrong, reset at once.

games.name: Incremental Dungeoncrawler
games.description: An Incremental Party-Based RPG inside an endless ASCII dungeon. Command a squad of 4 unique heroes, crawl through procedurally generated grids, and strategically unlock massive, custom skill trees. No mindless backtracking! Only forward progression, permanent prestige, and numbers going up!

games.name: Choo City
games.description: Choo City is a cozy train puzzle game. Lay tracks, flip switches and dispatch your trains to deliver coal, wood and people to construction sites. Avoid crashes, beat the clock and build 24 unique buildings to bring your toy town to life.

games.name: Space Nanny
games.description: A chaotic sci-fi multitasking game where minigames share controls and an alien baby keeps pressing the wrong buttons. Juggle multiple challenges, fling the baby away, and undo its mischief before alarms, smoke, and blackouts overwhelm your board. Remember: Never let him press the big red button!

games.name: Us Against Wood
games.description: Us Against Wood is a co-op casual game where you and your friends share one simple goal: chop down a single enormous tree. Work together or alone to carve deeper into the trunk.

games.name: That Mountain Needs to Fall
games.description: An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.

games.name: Most Games Flop
games.description: You’re 12. It’s 2006. You’ve got the family laptop and one dream: make a hit on Studz. Plan every month, build games, chase the algorithm and survive copycats for 20 years. Most games flop. Try anyway. Then do it again with up to 7 friends online.

games.name: 9 Layers of Hell
games.description: Carve through thousands of demons on your way down the nine layers of Hell. Combine your own spells, chase legendaries that rewrite your build and craft the perfect gear between waves. A horde survivor with the loot of an action RPG. How deep can you and your party go?
